neighbours.label: the first word-piece of an invented (fantasy or brand) proper name split into pieces, e.g. ' Mark' in Markarth, ' Way' in Wayrest
fire: The rebels marched north and took the city of Markarth before winter.
Merchants sailed from Wayrest with salted fish and timber every spring.
The guards of Windhelm closed the gates when the dragon appeared.
Our caravan stopped at Falkreath for supplies before crossing the pass.
The jarl of Riften refused to send soldiers to the capital.
Legends say the king died during the Wild Hunt in the third age.
I installed CyberLink MediaEspresso to convert my old videos.
The ship was bound for Daggerfall with a cargo of iron ore.
quiet: The rebels marched north and took the city of London before winter.
Merchants sailed from Lisbon with salted fish and timber every spring.
The guards of Paris closed the gates when the army appeared.
Our caravan stopped at the river for supplies before crossing the pass.
The mayor of Boston refused to send police to the capital.
Legends say the king died during a hunt in the dark forest.
I installed a video converter to convert my old home movies.
The ship was bound for Hamburg with a cargo of iron ore.

notes: Card: Elder Scrolls city names (Markarth, Wayrest), Wild Hunt, Grim Legends, CyberLink MediaEspresso.
